text: Poultry, from the red junglefowl. Broilers are bred for meat and reach slaughter weight in four to six weeks; layers are bred for eggs, and a modern layer approaches five hundred eggs. Nepal has three indigenous breeds: Sakini, the naked necked Ghanti Khuile, and the frizzled Pwankh Ulte, hardy birds for village scavenging.
